content: I'm not feeling too well. I've caught a cold.
Is it because of the bad weather? It's been really miserable for the past tew days.
Hasn't it! It's been cold and windy recently. Do you like the weather here?
Not really, but I've got used to it now.
Oh, I'm going for a trip to New York this autumn. What's the weather like in New York?
Not quite good. It's windy and dry. We have got continental climate there. It's dry all the year round. Usually autumn is the best season of the year In New York.
Is it cold in autumn there? Should I take any warm clothes with me?
No, it isn't very cold at that time. You'll only need some light wool clothing with somejackets and shirts.
